source.post_text:
grunge music went mainstream in America and Massive Attack release their seminal debut Album 🔥

what are your top 3 Albums from 1991? ▶️

replies.text: Blue Lines, Nevermind and Screamadelica for me - they offer a perfect balance of the year's big shifts in sound.
replies.author: decoy

replies.text: Lotta good music here but Nevermind changed music.
replies.author: @DukeCarter13

replies.text: Right. But Achtung Baby is a masterpiece. I would pick AB, Nevermind and then whatever
replies.author: @stephane_dissel

decoy_rationale: The phrasing is oddly balanced and slightly essay-like in explaining the 'perfect balance' rather than just naming favorites casually.
